blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Deploying deep learning models on edge CPUs is often bottlenecked by computational and memory constraints. To alleviate this, mixed-precision quantization promises to reduce inference latency while preserving model accuracy. However, quantization affects different layer types in subtle and inconsistent ways, and yet identifying where accuracy loss is minimized and latency reduction is maximized is critical, as the effect accumulates over a full deployment into substantial savings or unacceptable task degradation. Such identification relies on sensitivity metrics, proxies that estimate layer-wise degradation without evaluating the task accuracy of every candidate policy. Nevertheless, widely used metrics fail systematically on modern architectures. We present a systematic empirical study of 13 sensitivity metrics for layer-wise INT8 quantization across four distinctly different neural networks, and validate the resulting policies on two ARM64 platforms. Gradient-based sensitivity methods fail on 4 out of 8 model-hardware configurations and weight-based statistics on 2. In contrast, the Jensen-Shannon Divergence achieves zero catastrophic failures, reliably isolating the layers that cannot be safely quantized. These results complement previous studies by quantifying how much more reliable output-space divergences are than the commonly used gradient- and weight-based criteria. A sensitivity metric alone does not define a policy, and the fixed thresholds typically used for that step are fragile over the highly skewed distributions of modern architectures. We address this with K-Means clustering, achieving near-lossless accuracy and a mean speed-up of 1.81 × 1.81\times over the full-precision model. Finally, we reveal that excluding from quantization the layers whose speed-up is negligible, regardless of their sensitivity, can be counterproductive, as it induces computational graph fragmentation and disables operator fusion. Our results yield concrete allocation policies for practitioners and researchers deploying quantized vision models on heterogeneous edge CPUs, without GPU access or gradient computation. Code is available at https://github.com/davidpob99/ramp-mpq .
blocks.zh: 在边缘CPU上部署深层学习模型往往受到计算和内存限制的瓶颈. 为了缓解这种情况,混合精度量化承诺在保持模型精确性的同时减少推论延迟. 然而,量化以微妙和不一致的方式影响不同层次的类型,但确定在哪些方面将准确性损失减少到最低程度并最大限度地减少延迟至关重要,因为通过充分部署,这种效应会累积到大量节省或不可接受的任务退化中。 这种识别依赖于敏感性衡量标准,即不评估每个候选政策的任务准确性而估计分层退化的代词。 尽管如此,广泛使用的度量衡在现代建筑上还是系统失败. 我们提出了对13个敏感性度量度的系统经验研究,用于在四个截然不同的神经网络中进行分层INT8量化,并验证两个ARM64平台所产生的政策。 基于渐变的灵敏度方法在8个模型硬件配置和2个加权统计中4个失败. 与此相对照的是,詹森-沙农分化实现了零灾难性的失败,可靠地隔离了无法安全量化的层层. 这些结果补充了以往的研究,量化了与常用的梯度和权重标准相比,产出-空间差异的可靠性。 光是敏感度衡量标准并不能确定政策,而这一步骤通常使用的固定阈值相对于现代建筑高度扭曲的分布来说是脆弱的。 我们用K-Means群集来解决这个问题,实现几乎无损失的精确度,并在全精度模型上平均速度为1.81×1.81\时. 最后,我们揭示,将速度可忽略不计的地层从数量中排除,不管其敏感性如何,都会产生反效果,因为它会诱发计算图分裂,使操作员聚变失效。 我们的成果产生了具体的分配政策,供从业者和研究人员在不同的边缘CPU上部署量化的视觉模型,而无需GPU访问或梯度计算。 代码见https://github.com/davidpob99/ramp-mpq 。 。 。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Edge computing has become fundamental to many real-time applications, such as autonomous driving, robotics or mobile image recognition, where the deployment of deep learning models is strictly constrained by latency, energy consumption and memory footprint. These restrictions depend on the complexity of models being executed, which range from Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) to Vision Transformers (ViTs). Regardless of the architecture, these models, which are inherently designed for high-end servers, must be adapted to enable their execution on resource-constrained edge devices.
blocks.zh: 边际计算已经成为许多实时应用的基础,如自主驱动,机器人或移动图像识别,其中深度学习模型的部署受到耐久性,能量消耗和记忆足迹的严格限制. 这些限制取决于所执行的模型的复杂性,这些模型从革命神经网络(CNN)到视觉变形器(ViT)不等. 不论架构如何,这些模型本来就是为高端服务器设计的,必须加以调整,以便能够在受资源限制的边缘设备上执行。

blocks.en: To overcome these limitations, several approaches have been proposed to optimize model deployment. The first involves designing lightweight architectures, often leveraging Neural Architecture Search (NAS) [ 1 ] . However, this requires a large volume of expensive experiments to find ideal model designs for each specific task, and is typically performed during the model pre-training stage. The second focuses on compressing and accelerating existing, pre-trained models, thereby reducing the overall computational effort. These compression methods range from pruning (removing specific network components) [ 2 ] to quantization (reducing the numerical precision of tensors at the channel, layer, or group level) [ 3 ] . This work focuses on quantization due to its capacity to provide substantial hardware acceleration on edge devices without requiring access to the original training pipeline.
blocks.zh: 为了克服这些局限性,提出了优化模式部署的若干办法。 第一种涉及设计轻量级建筑,经常利用神经结构搜索(NAS)[1]. 然而,这需要大量昂贵的实验,为每项具体任务寻找理想的模型设计,并且通常在模型预训阶段进行. 第二个重点是压缩和加速现有的,预先训练好的模型,从而减少总体的计算努力. 这些压缩方法从挤压(删除特定的网络组件)[2]到量化(降低通道,层,或组级的百分位数的数值精度)[3]. 这项工作的重点是量化,因为它有能力在边缘设备上提供大量的硬件加速,而不需要进入原来的培训管道。

blocks.en: Uniform low-bitwidth quantization yields substantial speed-ups, but it often triggers catastrophic accuracy degradation. Modern architectures mix layer types whose tolerance to precision loss varies by orders of magnitude, so a single network-wide bit-width either sacrifices accuracy on the most sensitive layers or forgoes the available speed-up on the rest. Consequently, mixed-precision quantization (MPQ) has emerged as a robust alternative. Unlike uniform approaches, MPQ frameworks seek an optimal layer-wise bit-width allocation that balances task accuracy with physical hardware constraints, such as inference latency or model size. Existing MPQ approaches are highly diverse, ranging from computationally expensive search-based methods (e.g., Reinforcement Learning (RL)) [ 4 , 5 ] to criterion-based methods using Integer Linear Programming (ILP) [ 6 , 7 ] . Within these criterion-based methods, bit-width allocation is guided by evaluating layer sensitivity, which is the degree to which the quantization of a specific layer contributes to the overall degradation of the model’s performance. Although often effective, these traditional frameworks typically incur significant computational overheads during the policy search phase.
blocks.zh: 统一的低比特width量化产生大量的加速,但经常引发灾难性的精度退化. 现代建筑混合了层层类型,其对精度损失的耐受性因数量级而异,所以一个单一的网络宽比特宽要么牺牲最敏感的层的精度,要么放弃其余的可用速度. 因此,混合精度量化(MPQ)已成为一种强有力的替代办法。 与统一的方法不同,MPQ框架寻求一个最佳的依层比特宽分配,使任务精度与物理硬件限制相平衡,如推论延迟或模型大小. 现有的MPQ方法非常多样化,从计算昂贵的基于搜索的方法(例如加强学习)[4,5]到使用整数线程编程(ILP)[6,7]的标准方法. 在这些基于标准的方法中,位宽分配以评价层灵敏度为指导,即具体层的量化在多大程度上促成了模型性能的整体退化. 这些传统框架虽然往往有效,但通常在政策搜索阶段需要大量的计算间接费用。

blocks.en: Most existing quantization methods have been optimized for Graphics Processing Units (GPUs). However, many edge deployments rely strictly on general-purpose Central Processing Units (CPUs) due to their power-efficient properties and reduced cost, which is especially relevant in constrained environments. These scenarios exhibit fundamentally different execution characteristics. For instance, edge CPUs typically support a very limited set of native numerical precisions (predominantly 32-bit floating point (FP32) and 8-bit integer (INT8)) at the Instruction Set Architecture (ISA) level, making many sub-byte GPU optimizations inapplicable. Moreover, while the GPU ecosystem is relatively standardized, the CPU landscape is highly heterogeneous, comprising vastly different micro-architectures and instruction sets. Figure 1 illustrates the consequence. Under a single fixed deployment configuration, the end-to-end benefit of INT8 spans an order of magnitude across different CPUs, from a 5 × 5\times acceleration to a net slowdown. This variance underscores the importance of accounting for the target execution stack when designing quantization policies.
blocks.zh: 大部分现有的量化方法已经被优化用于图形处理单元(GPU). 然而,许多边缘部署都严格依赖通用的中央处理单位(CPU),因为它们具有节能特性,成本降低,这在受限制的环境中特别相关. 这些假想显示出根本不同的执行特征。 例如,边缘CPU通常在指令集架构(ISA)级别上支持一套非常有限的本土数值精度(主要是32位浮点(FP32)和8位整数(INT8)),使得许多子字节GPU优化不适用. 此外,虽然GPU生态系统相对标准化,但CPU地貌差异很大,由大不相同的微型建筑和指令集组成. 图1说明了后果。 在单一的固定部署配置下,INT8的端到端收益跨不同CPU的大小顺序,从5×5\的加速到净减速. 这一差异突出了设计量化政策时对目标执行堆栈进行核算的重要性。

blocks.en: To address these challenges, this work first conducts a systematic evaluation of existing sensitivity proxies and hardware profiling methods. We find that traditional metrics often fail to predict accuracy degradation in modern architectures. Additionally, standard latency modelling treats hardware awareness as a set of layer-level constraints, overlooking critical global-level overheads like computational graph fragmentation. We show that this fragmentation disables operator fusion and increases execution costs, which can lead to suboptimal deployment. Furthermore, we observe that common thresholding methods rely on fixed percentiles, which are fragile as they fail to account for the diverse sensitivity distributions of different architectures, while search-based methods are computationally expensive and unsuitable for resource-constrained CPUs. To resolve these issues, we propose a solver-free, criterion-based clustering method that uses K-Means to adaptively identify sensitivity breakpoints, optimizing the accuracy-latency trade-off on CPUs. Our primary contributions are summarized as follows:
blocks.zh: 为了应对这些挑战,这项工作首先对现有的敏感性代理和硬件剖析方法进行系统评价。 我们发现传统度量衡往往无法预测现代建筑的精度退化. 此外,标准延迟建模将硬件意识视为一组层层的制约,俯瞰关键的全球性间接费用,如计算图断裂. 我们显示,这种分裂会破坏操作员的聚变并增加执行成本,这可能导致部署不理想。 此外,我们还注意到,共同的阈值方法依赖于固定百分位数,这些百分位数很脆弱,因为它们没有考虑到不同架构的不同敏感性分布,而基于搜索的方法计算成本昂贵,不适合资源紧张的CPU。 为了解决这些问题,我们提出一种无解决方案,基于标准的集群方法,使用K-Means来适应性地识别灵敏度断点,优化CPU的精度-相关性权衡. 我们的主要贡献概述如下:

blocks.en: • Systematic Reassessment of Sensitivity Proxies: We show that Jensen-Shannon Divergence (JSD) is a better proxy for quantization degradation than gradient-based metrics, successfully preventing accuracy collapse in diverse architectures. • Revisiting Latency Modelling and Graph Fragmentation: We reveal that strictly enforcing layer-level constraints induces computational graph fragmentation and disables operator fusion, which outweighs the benefits of individual operator acceleration. • RAMP (Robust Adaptive Mixed-Precision Quantization): We introduce a solver-free method that applies 1D K-Means clustering to the JSD landscape to automatically generate adaptive and near-lossless quantization policies.
blocks.zh: • 系统重新评估敏感性近似性: 我们显示,Jensen-Shannon Divergence(JSD)比基于梯度的度量衡更能代表量化降解,成功防止了各种架构中的精度崩溃. • 重新审视延迟建模和图解: 我们揭示,严格执行层层限制会导致计算图破碎,使操作员聚变失效,这超过了单个操作员加速度的好处. • RAMP(罗布斯特适应性混合精度量化): 我们引入了一种无解析器方法,将1D K-Means集成到JSD的地貌上,以自动生成适应性和几乎无损失的量化政策.

blocks.en: Systematic Reassessment of Sensitivity Proxies: We show that Jensen-Shannon Divergence (JSD) is a better proxy for quantization degradation than gradient-based metrics, successfully preventing accuracy collapse in diverse architectures.
blocks.zh: 系统重新评估敏感性 邻位 : 我们显示,Jensen-Shannon Divergence(JSD)比基于梯度的度量衡更能代表量化降解,成功防止了各种架构中的精度崩溃.

blocks.en: 2 Background and Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 背景和有关工作

blocks.en: This section reviews the fundamentals of mixed-precision quantization and existing sensitivity proxies, followed by an overview of the hardware constraints that motivate our method.
blocks.zh: 本节回顾混合精度量化的基本原理和现有的灵敏度代词,然后综述激励我们方法的硬件制约因素.

blocks.en: 2.1 Mixed-Precision Quantization
blocks.zh: 2.1 混合精度量化

blocks.en: Fixed post-training quantization (PTQ) relies on applying a uniform bit-width across the entire network. However, this is inherently suboptimal [ 8 ] , as layers differ in their sensitivity to precision loss. Mixed-precision quantization (MPQ) is the process of assigning different numerical precisions to specific layers, channels, or tensors within a neural network. The primary objective is to maintain the most sensitive layers at a high precision while aggressively compressing those that contribute the least to overall model performance. This optimization problem grows exponentially with model size: given a candidate precision set B B and L L layers, the search space encompasses 𝒪 ⁡ ( | B | L ) \mathcal{O}(|B|^{L}) possible combinations. To explore this huge space, MPQ methods are generally classified into two categories based on their exploration strategy: search-based and criterion-based . In this paper, we focus on the latter, leveraging proxy metrics to quantify the degradation each individual layer introduces to the model.
blocks.zh: 固定的训练后量化(PTQ)依赖于在整个网络中应用一个统一的位宽. 然而,这在本质上是次优化的[8],因为各层对精度损失的敏感性不同。 混合精度量化(MPQ)是将不同的数值精度分配到神经网络内的特定层,通道,或变位器的过程. 首要目标是保持最敏感的层层高度精确,同时大力压缩对总体模型性能贡献最小的层层. 这个优化问题随模型大小而成指数增长:鉴于一个候选精度集B和L L层,搜索空间包含O QQ (  B | L)\mathcal{O}(| B|^{ L})可能的组合. 为了探索这个巨大的空间,MPQ方法一般根据其探索策略分为两类:基于搜索和标准. 在本文中,我们侧重于后者,利用代用度量法来量化模型引入的每一层退化。

blocks.en: These approaches empirically explore combinations within the design space using techniques such as Reinforcement Learning (RL) [ 4 , 9 ] , genetic algorithms [ 5 ] , or joint architecture search [ 1 , 10 , 11 , 12 , 13 ] . Consequently, their primary drawback is not only the severe computational overhead, often requiring days or weeks of compute to converge, but also the strict requirement for full access to the original training pipeline and entire dataset. In contrast, criterion-based methods guide allocation analytically rather than through empirical search. This avoids the expensive policy generation phase, making them vastly more efficient and practical for post-training edge deployment.
blocks.zh: 这些方法在经验上探索了设计空间内的组合,采用的技术包括加强学习[RL][4,9],遗传算法[5],或联合结构搜索[1,10,11,12,13]. 因此,它们的主要缺点不仅是严重的计算间接费用,往往需要数日或数周的计算才能汇合,而且严格要求充分进入原始培训管道和整个数据集。 与此相反,基于标准的方法在分析上而不是通过经验搜索来指导分配。 这避免了昂贵的政策制定阶段,使其在培训后边缘部署方面大为高效和实用。

blocks.en: These methods use computationally inexpensive proxy metrics to estimate the sensitivity of each layer to quantization. Sensitivity is defined as the extent to which quantizing a specific layer contributes to accuracy degradation or an increase in the loss function. In the literature, sensitivity proxies are generally divided into three main categories. First, Second-Order (Curvature-Based) Metrics estimate sensitivity based on the local curvature of the loss landscape, typically captured by the Hessian matrix via Taylor expansions (e.g., HAWQ-V2 [ 14 ] ). Second, Information-Theoretic Metrics are used in two different ways. Some methods quantify the information lost between the full-precision and the quantized model, typically via Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence [ 15 , 16 ] . Others score the information content of the model itself without comparing the two: Sun et al [ 17 ] derive the entropy of the last feature map, whereas Qin et al [ 18 ] measure the Shannon entropy of each layer’s activations and assign bit-widths against fixed percentiles of the resulting distribution. Finally, Signal Distortion Metrics rely on quantifying the local discrepancy between full-precision weights and their low-precision counterparts, employing standard distance measurements such as Signal-to-Quantization Noise Ratio (SQNR) [ 19 ] or Mean Squared Error (MSE) [ 20 ] .
blocks.zh: 这些方法使用计算成本低的代用计量法来估计每层对定量的敏感性. 灵敏度的定义是,对某一层进行量化在多大程度上有助于准确性降解或损失功能的增加。 在文献中,敏感代词一般分为三大类. 第一,第二顺序(基于法院) Metrics根据损失地貌的局部曲率来估计灵敏度,一般由黑森矩阵通过泰勒扩张(例如HAWQ-V2[14])捕获. 第二,信息理论 度量衡有两种不同的使用方式. 一些方法将完全精度和量化模型之间损失的信息量化,一般通过Kullback-Leibler(KL)差[15,16]. 其他人对模型本身的信息内容不作比较: Sun et al [17] 获得最后一个特征图的 en,而秦 et al [18] 测量每层活化的香农 en,并按产生的分布的固定百分位分配位宽. 最后,信号扭曲度量衡依赖于量化全精度权重与其低精度对等方之间的局部差异,采用信号对量噪比(SQNR)[19]或平均平方误差(MSE)[20]等标准距离测量.

blocks.en: Given a specific sensitivity metric, these approaches formulate an ILP [ 6 , 7 ] or Quadratic Programming (QP) [ 15 , 21 ] problem to minimize it subject to a set of constraints, which are primarily hardware-oriented, such as model size or inference latency [ 4 , 7 ] . This formulation bridges two orthogonal components: sensitivity, acting as a proxy for task degradation, and the physical constraints of the target hardware. However, because ILP solvers introduce significant computational overhead, many practical frameworks resort to rigid, rule-based heuristics, such as percentile thresholding [ 18 , 22 ] . While faster, these static thresholds fail to account for the highly skewed sensitivity distributions inherent to modern network architectures, directly motivating the need for more adaptive grouping mechanisms.
blocks.zh: 鉴于具体的灵敏度指标,这些方法提出了ILP[6, 7]或四方编程[QP][15, 21]问题,以尽量减少这一问题,但受一系列制约,这些制约主要是以硬件为导向的,如模型大小或推论延迟[4, 7]。 这种配体连接了两个正交部分:灵敏度,作为任务降解的代称,以及目标硬件的物理限制. 然而,由于ILP解析器引入了重大的计算间接费用,许多实用框架都采用了僵化的,基于规则的休眠法,如百分位阈值[18,22]. 这些静态阈值虽然更快,但未能说明现代网络架构所固有的高度扭曲的敏感性分布,直接激发了对更具适应性分组机制的需求.

blocks.en: 2.2 Target Hardware
blocks.zh: 2.2 目标硬件

blocks.en: Most MPQ methods target GPUs [ 14 , 7 , 6 ] , leaving CPU deployment under-explored. Unlike GPUs, edge CPUs exhibit high micro-architectural heterogeneity that complicates latency estimation. First , the physical implementation of instruction sets varies significantly across architectures (e.g., ARM64, x86-64), which can lead to counter-intuitive execution profiles where higher-precision operations are executed faster than lower-precision ones. Second , CPU performance is heavily bottlenecked by localized memory hierarchies (L1/L2 caches); the overhead of data movement often dictates the overall execution latency, making cache utilization as critical as arithmetic intensity. To address this gap in the literature, this study optimizes MPQ for general-purpose CPUs, centring its empirical scope to ARM64: it is the main edge deployment target and exposes INT8 uniformly at the ISA level, so the latency variance we observe is attributable to micro-architecture rather than to instruction availability.
blocks.zh: 大多数MPQ方法都针对GPU[14,7,6],使得CPU的部署探索不足. 与GPU不同,边缘CPU表现出高度的微结构异质性,使得延迟估计复杂化. 第一,不同架构(如ARM64,x86-64)对指令集的实际执行差异很大,这可能导致反直观执行配置,因为执行的精度更高的操作比精度较低的操作快. 第二,CPU的性能受到本地化内存分级(L1/L2缓存)的严重瓶颈;数据移动的间接费用往往决定了总体执行时空,使得缓存的利用与算术强度一样关键. 为解决文献中的这一差距,本研究优化了MPQ的通用CPU,其经验范围以ARM64为中心:它是主要边缘部署目标,并在ISA一级统一暴露INT8,因此我们观察到的延迟差异可归因于微结构化而非指令可用性.

blocks.en: 3 Problem Formulation
blocks.zh: 3 问题表述

blocks.en: Let a Deep Neural Network (DNN) be defined by a sequence of L L layers parameterized by full-precision weights W W . In MPQ, we define the set of available bit-widths as B = { b 0 , … , b n − 1 } B=\{b_{0},...,b_{n-1}\} . blocks.en: 4 Mixed-Precision Quantization
blocks.zh: 4 混合精度量化

blocks.en: This section establishes the sensitivity metric and the search policy. We first define an experimental setup across diverse architectures. Next, we analyse multiple proxies to identify the most effective metric for ranking sensitivity degradation. Finally, we introduce a distribution-adaptive thresholding technique based on K-Means clustering, which will serve as the core search engine for our subsequent quantization method.
blocks.zh: 本节规定了敏感性指标和搜索政策。 我们首先定义了 跨不同建筑的实验结构。 其次,我们分析多种代词,以确定对敏感性退化进行排名的最有效衡量标准。 最后,我们采用了一种基于K-Means集群的分布适应阈值技术,它将作为我们随后的量化方法的核心搜索引擎.

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en: We conduct a sensitivity analysis focused on accuracy preservation across diverse model architectures: ResNet-18 [ 23 ] , EfficientNet-B0 [ 24 ] , ConvNeXt-Tiny [ 25 ] and TinyViT [ 26 ] . We selected these models to cover a wide architectural spectrum, ranging from classical CNNs to modern ViTs. We evaluate on SuSy-Dataset [ 27 ] , a synthetic image classification dataset, to assess the impact of quantization beyond standard classification tasks. Deepfake detection relies on subtle high-frequency artifacts [ 28 , 29 ] that may be more susceptible to quantization-induced distortion than the coarse semantic features used in ImageNet classification, making this task a challenging testbed for our accuracy sensitivity experiments.
blocks.zh: 我们进行一项敏感性分析,重点是在不同模型结构中保持准确性:ResNet-18[23]、高效网-B0[24]、ConvNEXt-Tiny[25]和TinyViT[26]。 我们选择了这些模型来覆盖广泛的建筑谱面,从古典的CNN到现代的ViT. 我们评价一个合成图像分类数据集SuSy-Dataset[27],以评估除标准分类任务之外的量化的影响. 深假探测依赖于微妙的高频文物[28,29],这些文物可能比ImageNet分类中使用的粗糙语义特征更容易被量化引起的扭曲,使得这项任务成为我们精度敏感度实验的一个具有挑战性的试验床.

blocks.en: 4.2 Sensitivity Analysis
blocks.zh: 4.2 敏感性分析

blocks.en: We first evaluate the capacity of various sensitivity metrics to predict empirical accuracy degradation. To comprehensively assess these predictive proxies for quantization robustness, we select 13 diverse metrics from the literature and categorize them into three distinct representational spaces: • Parameter-Space Proxies. These metrics assess local tensor degradation based on structural properties (e.g., parameter count), statistical dispersion (standard deviation (STD), coefficient of variation of channel ranges, dynamic range ratios) and quantization noise heuristics (Signal-to-Noise Ratio (SNR) and Estimated Signal-to-Quantization-Noise Ratio (SQNR)). • Gradient-Space Proxies. Represented by the state-of-the-art Hessian trace approximation (HAWQ-V2 score [ 14 ] ), this category captures the local curvature of the loss landscape to estimate how weight perturbations affect the overall loss. • Output-Space Proxies. These proxies quantify the end-to-end semantic degradation via distance metrics (MSE, NRMSE, MAE, Cosine Dissimilarity) and information-theoretic divergences (Kullback-Leibler (KL) and Jensen-Shannon Divergence (JSD)) computed directly on the final classification logits.

blocks.en: To evaluate each sensitivity metric, we employ a One-At-a-Time (OAT) analysis. First, we extract the reference weights and output logits from the full-precision baseline model. Subsequently, the network is independently quantized L L times, quantizing only a single layer l l per iteration while retaining the rest in full precision. The sensitivity metrics are then computed by comparing the full-precision baseline against each of the L L resulting models. This approach ensures that we capture the global impact of a single-layer perturbation on the network’s overall dynamics and final output logits, rather than measuring isolated local errors for output-space proxies [ 6 ] . Nevertheless, this method ignores inter-layer dependencies and error accumulation under joint quantization, a limitation shared by criterion-based MPQ methods [ 14 , 7 ] . What OAT does provide is a ranking of individually sensitive layers, which Section 6 shows to be sufficient to build joint policies that avoid accuracy collapse.
blocks.zh: 为了评估每个敏感性指标,我们采用一次性分析。 首先,我们从全精度基线模型中提取参考加权数和输出对数。 随后,网络被独立地量化LL倍数,每迭数只量化一个单层ll,同时完全精确地保留其余部分. 然后通过将全精度基线与产生的LL模型进行比较来计算敏感性度量。 这种方法确保我们掌握单层扰动对网络总体动态和最终产出记录的全球影响,而不是测量输出空间代号的孤立局部错误[6]。 尽管如此,这种方法忽略了在联合量化下层之间的依赖性和误差积累,这是基于标准的MPQ方法共享的限制[14,7]. OAT确实提供的是个人敏感层的排名,第6节显示这足以建立避免精度崩溃的联合政策.

blocks.en: To determine which of these metrics best explains accuracy degradation, we establish a multi-phase evaluation protocol. First, we compute pairwise Spearman correlations [ 30 ] across all evaluated proxies to identify redundancies. Second, we correlate the remaining metrics directly against the empirical accuracy degradation, calculated via the OAT approach. We use this correlation as a sanity check rather than as a selection criterion, since output-space proxies are computed on the same logits whose argmax defines accuracy and are therefore favoured by construction. However, in MPQ, identifying the exact magnitude of the accuracy drop or its global correlation is secondary to correctly ranking and retrieving the most vulnerable layers. Therefore, as our primary evaluation criterion, we introduce a Recall@Top- N % N\% metric. For a given percentile threshold N % N\% , we define the number of target layers as k = ⌊ L × N 100 ⌋ k=\lfloor L\times\frac{N}{100}\rfloor . blocks.en: 4.3 Distribution-Adaptive Thresholding
blocks.zh: 4.3 分布式轴承

blocks.en: While a sensitivity metric like JSD accurately quantifies the expected degradation from quantizing a specific layer l l , it is necessary to establish a policy that selects layers based on this metric. To solve the constrained optimization problem defined in Equation 2 , traditional algorithms typically rely on ILPs [ 6 , 7 ] or, in recent years, RL [ 9 , 1 ] , which are computationally expensive. Another approach is to use rigid heuristic methods, such as percentile-based selection, which lack robustness against outliers.
blocks.zh: 虽然像JSD这样的灵敏度度量精确地量化了从一个特定层l的量化中预期的降解,但有必要制定政策,根据这一度量选择层. 为了解决方程式2中定义的受限优化问题,传统算法通常依赖于ILP [6,7] 或近年来的RL [9,1],它们计算成本昂贵. 另一种方法是采用僵硬的heuristic方法,例如以百分位为基础的选择,这些方法对外部者缺乏强性。

blocks.en: To establish an automated method that accounts for the disparity in the sensitivity metric distribution (without assuming normality), we introduce a distribution-adaptive thresholding mechanism based on K-Means clustering [ 32 ] . Let Ω = { Ω 1 , Ω 2 , … , Ω L } \Omega=\{\Omega_{1},\Omega_{2},\dots,\Omega_{L}\} be the continuous sensitivity scores extracted via our OAT profiling for all L L layers. Our objective is to partition Ω \Omega into K K discrete groups C = { c 1 , … , c K } C=\{c_{1},\dots,c_{K}\} , where K K determines the granularity of the quantization policy (e.g., K = 5 K=5 for fine-grained separation). We solve this by minimizing the within-cluster variance. In contrast, the percentile baseline yields negative silhouette values, mathematically proving that rigid quotas arbitrarily fragment groups of structurally identical layers. The remaining evaluated models suffer from this same behaviour due to the highly skewed nature of modern sensitivity distributions; ResNet presents the smoothest distribution, followed by ConvNeXt, EfficientNet and TinyViT. This progression strictly aligns with the quantization difficulty observed in our previous experiments, demonstrating that fixed percentiles trigger accuracy collapse by blindly quantizing topological outliers, whereas our K-Means approach automatically preserves model semantics.

blocks.en: 5 Hardware Impact
blocks.zh: 5 硬件冲击

blocks.en: While MPQ is often used to balance model accuracy and inference latency, assuming that lower precision automatically speeds up execution is often wrong in practice. Even though INT8 theoretically offers better computational speed and uses less memory bandwidth than standard FP32, these benefits heavily depend on the specific hardware architecture, instruction sets and the computational workload of each layer.
blocks.zh: 虽然MPQ经常用于平衡模型精度和推断延迟,但假设较低的精度自动加速执行在实践中往往是错误的. 尽管INT8理论上比标准FP32提供更好的计算速度,并使用更少的内存带宽,但这些好处很大程度上依赖于每个层的特定硬件架构,指令集和计算工作量.

blocks.en: To test the impact of hardware, we profile the models of Section 4 on three CPUs from different vendors: an Apple M1, a Raspberry Pi 5 (Cortex-A76) and an Intel Core i9-12900KF. The first two are ARM64 and constitute our main evaluation setting, while the third is x86-64 and serves to characterize cross-ISA variability. All experiments use ONNX Runtime [ 34 ] , which supports node-level MPQ and is widely used in production, with the default CPU execution provider and only FP32 and INT8 precisions, since both are natively supported by these ISAs.
blocks.zh: 为了测试硬件的影响,我们描述了第4节的模型对来自不同供应商的三个CPU:一个Apple M1,一个Raspberry Pi 5(Cortex-A76)和一个Intel Core i9-12900KF. 前两个是ARM64,构成我们的主要评价环境,而第三个是x86-64,用于描述跨ISA的变异性。 所有实验都使用ONNX Runtime [34],它支持节点级的MPQ,并广泛用于生产,默认的CPU执行提供者只有FP32和INT8精度,因为两者都得到了这些ISA的本土支持.

blocks.en: As anticipated, the speed-up achieved by INT8 quantization is not uniform across CPU architectures. Figure 3 illustrates the per-layer speed-up for ConvNeXt-Tiny on both platforms, measured as the difference in ONNX Runtime profiling time between FP32 and INT8 execution. Despite the identical model and runtime configuration, the two platforms behave markedly differently: convolutional layers reach 6 × 6\times to 15 × 15\times on the Apple M1, whereas on the Cortex-A76 only a minority exceed 6 × 6\times . All tested models present similar behaviours.
blocks.zh: 如预期,INT8四化实现的速度在CPU架构上并不统一. 图3显示ConvNEXt-Tiny在两个平台的每层速度,作为ONNX运行时剖析时间中FP32和INT8执行的差值计量. 尽管模式和运行时间配置相同,但两个平台的表现明显不同:在Apple M1上,革命层达到6×6\时,达到15×15\时,而在Cortex-A76上,少数只超过6×6\时。 所有经过测试的模型都有类似的行为。

blocks.en: This disparity becomes more pronounced when comparing platforms with different ISAs. On x86-64, the default ONNX Runtime CPU provider not only fails to accelerate inference under INT8, but in several cases degrades latency relative to FP32 execution. Switching to OpenVINO [ 35 ] , Intel’s preferred execution backend for deep neural networks, recovers positive speed-ups, though these remain modest, consistently below 1.4 × 1.4\times .
blocks.zh: 在将平台与不同的《国际审计准则》进行比较时,这种差异变得更加明显。 在x86-64上,默认的ONNX Runtime CPU提供商不仅无法在INT8下加速推论,而且有几次会相对于FP32执行而降低延迟. 切换到深神经网络的首选执行后端OpenVINO [35], 恢复正速, 虽然这些速度仍然微乎其微, 始终低于1.4 × 1.

blocks.en: Several factors contribute to this architecture-dependent behaviour. First , ISA differences directly affect integer arithmetic throughput: in contrast to ARM64 platforms with tightly integrated NEON/AMX low-precision execution paths, x86-64 INT8 performance is more heterogeneous, as acceleration depends on the presence of AVX2/AVX512 VNNI or AMX instructions and on backend-specific kernel selection mechanisms (e.g., oneDNN [ 36 ] or FBGEMM [ 37 ] ). Second , differences in L1/L2 cache capacity and memory bandwidth affect weight loading latency, which dominates runtime for small tensors [ 38 ] . Third , and critically, converting weights and activations to INT8 does not guarantee improved latency, because quantization and dequantization operations introduce additional data movement overhead that in some cases surpasses the performance benefits of using lower precision, an effect that is particularly pronounced for layers with low arithmetic intensity, such as small depthwise convolutions, where the cost of type conversion exceeds the savings from reduced computation [ 39 , 40 ] .
blocks.zh: 有几个因素促成了这种依赖架构的行为。 首先,ISA差异直接影响整数算术吞吐量:与严格集成的近地物体N/AMX低精度执行路径的ARM64平台相比,x86-64INT8性能更为多样,因为加速度取决于AVX2/AVX512 VNNI或AMX指令的存在以及后端特有的内核选择机制(例如1DNN [36]或FBGEMM [37]). 第二,L1/L2缓存容量和内存带宽的差异影响重量加载延迟,这支配了小百合的运行时间[38]. 第三,而且关键的是,将权重和激活转换到INT8并不能保证提高耐久性,因为量化和减量化操作引入了额外的数据移动管理费,在某些情况下,它超过了使用较低精度的性能效益,这种效应对于算术强度低的层来说尤为明显,比如小深度的演化,在这种演化中,类型转换的成本超过了从减少的计算中节省的费用[39,40].

blocks.en: These observations have a direct consequence for MPQ policy design. Under the additive cost model prevalent in the literature, where end-to-end latency is treated as the sum of independent layer costs, they imply that a layer yielding negative or negligible speed-up should never be quantized regardless of its sensitivity score, as it degrades latency while injecting unnecessary quantization noise. This motivates use of per-layer latency profiling as a first-class signal in the quantization policy, rather than treating all layers as equally beneficial candidates for INT8 or relying strictly on theoretical bit allocation. We treat this implication as a hypothesis rather than an assumption, and evaluate it as an explicit ablation in Section 6.2 .
blocks.zh: 这些意见直接影响到MPQ政策设计。 根据文献中流行的添加剂成本模型,将端到端延迟作为独立层成本的总和处理,这意味着一个产生负或可忽略不计速度的层无论它的灵敏度得分如何,都永远不应被量化,因为它在注入不必要的定量噪声的同时降解了延迟. 这激发了将每个层的延迟剖面分析作为量化政策中的一流信号,而不是将所有层都作为INT8的同等受益候选人或严格依赖理论位分配. 我们把这一含义视为一种假设,而不是一种假设,并在第6.2节中把它视为一种明显的减损。

blocks.en: 6 The RAMP Method
blocks.zh: 6. RAMP方法

blocks.en: To address the MPQ problem, we propose RAMP ( R obust A daptive M ixed- P recision), a robust and solver-free method. The RAMP pipeline operates through three stages:

Distribution-Adaptive Thresholding: Using K-Means clustering to autonomously discover natural sensitivity breakpoints within the layer distribution. 3. Candidate Policy Generation: Deriving one policy per ordered cluster centroid, from which the operational policy is selected on the Pareto front.

blocks.en: This end-to-end pipeline is formalized in Algorithm 1 . Compared to state-of-the-art MPQ methods that rely on computationally expensive search strategies, such as ILP or RL, our approach incurs minimal computational overhead while obviating the need for arbitrary, hand-tuned sensitivity thresholds.

blocks.en: Algorithm 1 RAMP: Robust Adaptive Mixed-Precision Quantization
blocks.zh: 算法 1 RAMP:强适应性混合精度量子化

blocks.en: To determine the optimal operational policy that best balances accuracy preservation and latency reduction, we construct a Pareto front by plotting the accuracy versus latency for the K K candidate policies generated by RAMP. The optimal policy is selected using the knee-point (elbow) method, identifying the point of maximum curvature, which represents the optimal trade-off where additional latency reductions would necessitate a disproportionate sacrifice in model accuracy.
blocks.zh: 为了确定最佳的业务政策,以最佳平衡准确性保存和减少延迟,我们通过规划RAMP产生的K K候选人政策的准确性和延迟性,构建了Pareto阵线。 选择最佳政策时采用膝盖点(elbow)方法,确定最大曲率点,这代表了最佳的权衡,即额外暂时性减少需要在模型准确性方面作出不相称的牺牲。

blocks.en: We conduct an end-to-end validation of our method using the models and dataset introduced in Section 4 , alongside the hardware and framework specified in Section 5 .
blocks.zh: 我们使用第4节引入的模型和数据集,连同第5节具体规定的硬件和框架,对我们的方法进行端到端验证。

blocks.en: 6.1 End-to-End Validation
blocks.zh: 6.1 终到终验证

blocks.en: Based on the preceding sensitivity and hardware profiling analyses, we evaluate our distribution-adaptive K-Means thresholding method using three hardware-agnostic sensitivity criteria, corresponding to the best-performing representative of each proxy family identified in Section 4 : output-space (JSD), parameter-space (STD) and gradient-space (HAWQ-V2). A fourth, hardware-aware variant (JSD+Latency) is introduced and analysed as an ablation in Section 6.2 . This evaluation is conducted across both target CPU platforms. As reference points we include the FP32 model and uniform INT8 quantization, the fixed PTQ scheme described in Section 2 , whose end-to-end speed-up was already reported in Figure 1 . We consider two metrics: test set accuracy and median inference time per image (latency). The optimal policy is selected using the knee-point method described before.
blocks.zh: 根据上述敏感度和硬件剖面分析,我们利用三种硬件不可知性敏感性标准,评价我们的分布适应K-Means阈值方法,这些标准与第4节(输出空间(JSD),参数空间(STD)和梯度空间(HAWQ-V2))中确定的每个代理家族的最佳表现代表相对应. 第四,硬件感知变体(JSD+Latency),作为消歧义在第6.2节中被引入和分析. 这项评价在两个目标CPU平台进行。 作为参考点,我们包括FP32模型和统一的INT8量化法,第2节中描述的固定PTQ方案,其端到端速度已经在图1中报告. 我们考虑两个衡量标准:每张图像的测试精确度和中位推论时间(相关性)。 最佳政策采用前面描述的膝盖点法选择.

blocks.en: Table 2 summarizes the empirical results of this end-to-end validation. First , uniform INT8 collapses on three of the four architectures, losing between 28 28 and 70 70 accuracy points, and only the classical residual CNN survives it. This underscores the necessity of mixed-precision policies. Second , some hardware-agnostic baselines fail inconsistently depending on the network topology: STD collapses in 2 of the 8 configurations and HAWQ-V2 in 4, and their failure sets are disjoint, so neither heuristic dominates the other. Their failures concentrate on architectures with highly skewed, non-residual sensitivity distributions, where second-order weight approximations misrank the critical layers. Measuring sensitivity directly in the output-activation space via JSD avoids this failure mode, as it observes the end-to-end effect of the perturbation rather than a local curvature estimate.

blocks.en: Our proposed JSD-driven thresholding completely avoids performance degradation across all evaluated models and hardware platforms. For instance, on the highly sensitive TinyViT architecture, JSD achieves near-lossless accuracy (97.3% on the Apple M1 and 97.4% on the Raspberry Pi 5) compared to the FP32 baseline (97.5%), while unlocking substantial hardware acceleration (e.g., reducing ConvNeXt-Tiny latency from 168 ms to 95 ms on the Raspberry Pi 5). Overall, end-to-end robustness follows the ranking established in Table 1 : JSD (0.766 mean recall) incurs no failures, whereas HAWQ-V2 (0.509) and STD (0.496) fail in 4 and 2 of the 8 configurations respectively. Recall@Top- N % N\% over the sensitivity proxies is therefore predictive of deployment robustness, which validates the metric selection of Section 4 .
blocks.zh: 我们提议的JSD驱动阈值完全避免了所有被评价模型和硬件平台的性能退化. 例如,在高度敏感的TinyViT架构上,与FP32基线(97.5%)相比,JSD实现了近乎无损的精度(97.3%在苹果M1上,97.4%在Raspberry Pi5上),同时解锁了大量硬件加速(例如,将ConvNeXt-Tiny latency从168 ms降低到95 ms在Raspberry Pi5上). 总的来说,端到端的稳健程度与表1确定的排名相同:JSD(0.766 平均召回)没有出现故障,而HAWQ-V2(0.509)和STD(0.496)在8个配置中分别有4个和2个故障. 回顾@ 顶 因此,N% NQQ在敏感度上的代词可以预测部署的稳健性,这证实了第4节的度量选择。

blocks.en: 6.2 Graph Fragmentation
blocks.zh: 6.2 图解

blocks.en: We now evaluate the hypothesis formulated in Section 5 , namely that layers yielding negligible speed-up should be excluded from quantization. We implement it as a streamlined two-stage pipeline, denoted JSD+Latency. First , we filter out layers that do not yield a hardware speed-up greater than a given threshold t t (e.g., t = 1 t=1 ). Second , we apply the sensitivity-driven policy allocation of Section 6 on the remaining layers. This strategy incorporates real hardware measurements rather than hardware simulations, using a simple and time-efficient procedure. To assess it, we compare JSD-only against JSD+Latency across all configurations. As shown in Table 2 , both methods prevent accuracy collapse in all tested architectures (0 failures out of 8 configurations), with mean accuracy drops of 0.59 % 0.59\% and 0.45 % 0.45\% respectively, a negligible difference. The filter does not compensate for this on the latency side either: it degrades end-to-end inference time in 4 out of 8 configurations, improves it in 2, and leaves it unchanged in 2. Critically, these degradations are not uniformly distributed across platforms. On the Apple M1 the filter is neutral (at most 21.8 21.8 ms to 22.4 22.4 ms on ConvNeXt-Tiny), whereas on the Raspberry Pi 5 it degrades 3 out of 4 models: ConvNeXt-Tiny increases from 94.6 94.6 ms to 115.5 115.5 ms and TinyViT from 124.8 124.8 ms to 144.1 144.1 ms, both at identical accuracy, while ResNet-18 increases from 20.8 20.8 ms to 49.7 49.7 ms ( 2.4 × 2.4\times ) for a gain of 0.5 0.5 accuracy points.
blocks.zh: 现在,我们评价第5节提出的假设,即应把产生可忽略不计速度的层次排除在量化之外。 我们把它作为简化的两阶段管道执行,即JSD+Latency。 首先,我们过滤出不会产生大于给定阈值 t t 的硬件加速的层(例如 t = 1 t = 1). 第二,我们将第6节的敏感性政策分配应用于其余各层。 这个策略包含了真实的硬件测量而不是硬件模拟,使用简单和时间效率高的程序. 为了评估,我们只比较JSD与所有配置的JSD+Latency. 如表2所示,两种方法都防止了所有测试架构的精度崩溃(8个配置中有0个失败),平均精度下降分别为0.59% 0.59\%和0.45% 0.45\%,差异可忽略不计. 滤波器在耐久性方面也不补偿这一点:它在8个配置中的4个配置中降解了端到端的推论时间,在2个配置中改进,在2个配置中保持不变. 严重的是,这些退化并非在平台上统一分布。 在Apple M1上,过滤器是中性的(在ConvNEXt-Tiny上最多21.8 21.8 ms至22.4 22.4 ms),而在Raspberry Pi 5上,它降解了4种模型中的3种: ConvNEXt-Tiny从94.6 94.6 ms增加到115.5 115.5 ms和TinyViT从124.8 124.8 ms增加到144.1 144.1 ms,两者的精确度相同,而ResNet-18则从20.8 20.8 ms增加到49.7 49.7 ms(2.4×2.4\时),以获得0.5的精确点.

blocks.en: The mechanism behind this degradation is the execution engine rather than the individual operators. As shown in Figure 4 , forcing a subset of memory-bound layers into FP32 fragments contiguous INT8 subgraphs, introducing Quantize/Dequantize (Q/DQ) conversion nodes that prevent operator fusion and increase subgraph latency from 7.7 7.7 ms to 16.5 16.5 ms ( 2.1 × 2.1\times ), a graph fragmentation effect documented in GPU inference compilers [ 41 ] . The cost of breaking a contiguous integer region therefore exceeds the latency saved by protecting the individual layers inside it, which explains why a filter that is provably correct at the layer level becomes counterproductive end-to-end.
blocks.zh: 这种退化背后的机制是执行引擎而不是单个操作员. 如图4所示,强迫一子集内存层成FP32碎片毗连INT8子图,引入了Quantize/Dequantize(Q/DQ)转换节点,防止操作员聚变,并将子图的纬度从7.7ms提高到16.5ms(2.1×2.1\times),GPU推论编译器中记录的一种图解作用[41]. 因此,打破一个毗连整数区域的代价超过了保护其中各层所节省的耐久性,这解释了为什么一个在层层上可以证明正确的过滤器会变成适得其反的端到端.

blocks.en: Figure 4: Impact of Graph Fragmentation on ConvNeXt-Tiny (Cortex-A76). The unoptimized, isolated FP32 fallback more than doubles the execution time of memory-bound depthwise convolutions (from 7.7 ms to 16.5 ms per inference), heavily degrading overall latency despite no significant increase in Q/DQ overhead.
blocks.zh: 图4:图解对ConvNEXt-Tiny(Cortex-A76)的影响。 未经优化、孤立的FP32回落比内存深度进化的执行时间增加了一倍以上(从每推论7.7 ms降至16.5 ms),尽管Q/DQ的间接费用没有显著增加,但总体延迟严重降低。

blocks.en:
This result invalidates the assumption that execution time is strictly additive across layers, on which the ILP formulations used by criterion-based MPQ methods [ 7 , 6 ] directly rely: a per-layer cost table cannot express a penalty that depends on the precision assigned to neighbouring layers. It also refines the hardware heterogeneity characterized in Section 5 . Hardware still dictates the outcome, as evidenced by the fact that the filter is harmful on the Cortex-A76 and neutral on the Apple M1, but it is not actionable as a per-layer gating signal, since the effective unit of hardware awareness on CPU execution engines is the contiguous integer subgraph. Consequently, we exclude latency profiling from RAMP: on ARM64 platforms with
native INT8 SIMD support, JSD alone selects a low-sensitivity layer pool that provides adequate end-to-end speed-up without any on-device measurement, and the resulting policy transfers unchanged across both platforms.
blocks.zh:
这一结果使得执行时间严格是跨层添加的假设无效,基于标准的MPQ方法所使用的ILP配方[7,6]直接依赖这一假设:每层成本表不能表示取决于分配给邻近层的精度的处罚. 它还改进了第5节中描述的硬件异质性。 硬件仍然支配着结果,其证明是滤波器在Cortex-A76上有害,在Apple M1上是中性的,但是它不能作为每层的吉打信号来操作,因为CPU执行引擎上硬件意识的有效单位是毗连的整数子图. 因此,我们从RAMP中排除了延迟剖析:在ARM64平台上,
本地INT8 SIMD支持,JSD单独选择一个低灵敏度层池,在没有任何在线设备测量的情况下,提供足够的端到端加速,由此产生的政策转移在两个平台之间没有变化.

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion and Future Work
blocks.zh: 7 结论和今后的工作

blocks.en: 7.1 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7.1 结论

blocks.en: We conducted a comprehensive analysis of sensitivity metrics across four distinct model architectures and two ARM64 CPU platforms, demonstrating that information-theoretic metrics based on final output logits most accurately capture model degradation. Specifically, our empirical study shows that JSD, coupled with 1D K-Means clustering, consistently prevents the catastrophic accuracy collapse observed in both uniform quantization and state-of-the-art Hessian-based methods, particularly in modern Vision Transformers. Consequently, RAMP achieves near-lossless accuracy while delivering substantial inference speed-ups across diverse ARM64 platforms.
blocks.zh: 我们对四个不同的模型结构和两个ARM64 CPU平台的敏感性度量度进行了全面分析,表明基于最终输出日志的信息理论度量最准确地捕捉模型退化。 具体地说,我们的经验研究表明,JSD加上1D K-Means群集,始终防止在统一的量化和最先进的黑森方法中观察到的灾难性精度崩溃,特别是在现代的视觉变形器中. 因此,RAMP实现了几乎无损失的准确性,同时在各种ARM64平台上提供了大量的推论速度。

blocks.en: Crucially, we characterize the phenomenon of graph fragmentation in CPU execution engines, revealing that maintaining contiguous integer subgraphs has a more significant impact on end-to-end latency than the optimization of isolated layer-wise execution times. These findings challenge the prevailing assumption that mixed-precision latency can be accurately modeled as a simple additive sum of independent layer costs. Ultimately, RAMP offers a robust and practical pipeline for deploying state-of-the-art vision models on resource-constrained edge devices, eliminating the need for retraining or architecture-specific tuning.
blocks.zh: 关键是,我们对CPU执行引擎中的图解现象的特征,揭示出保持毗连整数子图对端到端间歇性的影响比优化孤立的层层执行时间更为显著. 这些调查结果对普遍的看法提出了质疑,即混合精度延迟可以精确地模拟为独立层成本的简单添加剂总和。 归根结底,RAMP为在受资源限制的边缘装置上部署最先进的视觉模型提供了一个强有力和实用的管道,从而不再需要再培训或针对特定结构的调整。

blocks.en: 7.2 Future Work
blocks.zh: 7.2 今后的工作

blocks.en: Four limitations delimit the scope of our results and define its natural extensions. First , while our distribution-adaptive thresholding effectively generates robust MPQ policies, the realization of physical speed-ups remains inherently tied to the underlying execution engine: preliminary evaluations on x86-64 (Intel Core i9-12900KF) using the default ONNX Runtime CPU provider resulted in unexpected latency degradation across all models, and achieving the theoretical hardware efficiency strictly necessitates vendor-optimized backends such as OpenVINO, whose integration for non-ARM architectures remains a key avenue for future work. Second , the proposed pipeline has been exclusively evaluated on image classification benchmarks; dense prediction tasks and natural language processing inherently exhibit fundamentally different activation distributions and structural vulnerabilities, so validating the transferability of our method across these domains remains critical. Third , as a data-driven PTQ method, the reliability of JSD relies heavily on the representativeness of the calibration dataset: if it fails to capture out-of-distribution features or rare edge cases, the K-Means algorithm may misclassify structurally critical layers as low-sensitivity, making calibration-free (zero-shot) thresholding an open challenge. Finally , our one-at-a-time profiling does not take into account interactions between layers; while the computed ranking is sufficient to generate robust policies in the binary FP32/INT8 regime, the resulting policies may be suboptimal, and extending the sensitivity analysis to block-wise measurement is a natural next step.
blocks.zh: 四个限制因素决定了我们成果的范围并确定了其自然延伸。 首先,虽然我们的分配适应阈值有效产生了强大的MPQ政策,但实现物理速度提升仍然与基础执行引擎有着内在的联系:使用默认的ONNX运行时CPU提供者对x86-64(Intel Core i9-12900KF)进行初步评价,导致所有模型中意外的耐久性退化,实现理论硬件效率,严格要求OpenVINO等供应商优化后端,其整合非ARM架构仍然是未来工作的关键途径. 第二,拟议的管道完全根据图像分类基准进行了评价;密集的预测任务和自然语言处理本身就显示出根本不同的激活分布和结构弱点,因此验证我们的方法在这些领域中的可转让性仍然至关重要。 第三,作为一种数据驱动的PTQ方法,JSD的可靠性在很大程度上依赖于校准数据集的代表性:如果它不能捕捉到分布外的特征或罕见的边缘案例,K-Means算法可能会将结构上的关键层误归类为低灵敏度,使校准无(零射)阈值成为公开挑战. 最后,我们一次性的剖面分析没有考虑到各层之间的相互作用;虽然计算出的排名足以在二进制FP32/INT8制度中产生强有力的政策,但由此产生的政策可能不尽人意,将敏感性分析扩大到分块衡量是自然的下一步。
